rationale: C07 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It concerns an airline carrier and reproduces essentially the child's entire sequence: the same three WHEREAS findings under the Railway Labor Act, the National Mediation Board's judgment that the dispute threatens interstate commerce and essential transportation service to a large section of the country, a thirty-day reporting requirement, and the section 10 prohibition on changing disputed conditions. C23 is also exceptionally close and additionally names the International Association of Machinists, but its plural-dispute formulation and supersession clause require more adaptation. C18 shares the same singular-dispute machinery and 'large section' formulation but concerns a non-airline carrier.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Northwest Airlines, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the International Association of Machinists, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the National Airlines, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Air Line Pilots Association, International, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The opening sentence uses the same detailed syntactic template for identifying an airline carrier, represented employees, and their labor organization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the national Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a large section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a large section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive factual and legal finding is identical apart from capitalization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The reporting obligation and deadline are verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Northwest Airlines, Inc., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the National Airlines, Inc.., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The operative section 10 standstill provision is reproduced almost verbatim, with only the carrier name changed.
